planets.name: K2-344 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-344 with a 3.36-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: K2-344 b was found in 2021 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-344. Its orbit and size follow de Leon et al. 2021's fit, the archive's default.
